text:
mira: infra-bot just fired a sustained pool_saturation alert for hosted-euc1 GPUs — p95 queue jumped from ~40ms to 1.2s over ~12m. dashboard: https://redwood.insights/d/queues/euc1

infra-bot: ALERT: hosted-euc1 gpu_pool_admission_throttle active (severity: warning). headroom=3%, queued=187, evictions/sec=12

alex: seeing the same. admission throttle count spiking, autoscaler didn’t add nodes. any deploys or config changes?

sam: no infra deploys. noted we rolled a kv-cache size tweak for model-x yesterday evening — could be causing evictions+rewarm churn.

mira: metrics show kv_cache_hit_rate dropped ~18% starting 03:14 UTC; evictions spike aligns with queue growth. queued requests also have higher median token lengths.

jamie: quick metric pull from one host: 
```
curl -s 'http://metrics-host/euc1/summary' | jq '.pools.gpu.hosted | {headroom,queued,evictions_per_s}'
```
sample output: `{ "headroom": 0.03, "queued": 193, "evictions_per_s": 11 }`

oncall-ops: I'm starting a manual scale now (+4 nodes) to buy time. will monitor for 10m.

alex: also seeing proxy retry rate increasing at same window. could be transient SNAT exhaustion on egress NAT gateways — worth checking net metrics on gateway nodes.

sam: running `ss -s` on a few worker nodes; seeing higher orphan sockets but not full exhaustion yet. logs show repeated model reloads at 03:16-03:20 which matches evictions.

mira: proposed plan: 1) keep manual scale until we confirm autoscaler behavior 2) rollback kv-cache change on model-x canary to test correlation 3) if queued >250 after 15m, escalate to P1 and page SRE.

jamie: rolled back kv-cache tweak on model-x canary at 03:34 UTC (patch abc123).

infra-bot: action log: manual_scale +4 nodes by oncall-ops at 03:22 UTC; kv-cache rollback by jamie at 03:34 UTC.

mira: good. alex, can you grab autoscaler logs for 03:10-03:30 and open a quick PR note?

alex: on it — collecting logs now and will paste the excerpts into the incident thread.

oncall-ops: update 03:42 UTC: queue down to 62, p95 ~260ms, evictions down to 2/s. manual nodes draining.

mira: thanks everyone — keeping this thread open for autoscaler follow-up. if we see another sustained uptick we promote and page.
